page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, this instance provides dedicated, non-shared compute resources, eliminating noisy-neighbor performance degradation.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. To support high-throughput data transfers, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, facilitating rapid communication with external storage volumes and other network resources.

Given its high core count, dedicated CPU allocation, and substantial network bandwidth, the ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. It is well-suited for large-scale web serving, application servers, distributed analytics, and database hosting where consistent CPU performance and high network throughput are critical.
